Doc docs/delivery/changes/CR-20260913-nen-tang-da-nguoi-dung.md (CR nen tang da nguoi dung, BL-20260913-001) - dac biet Nhom A-F o muc 4 va luong UI o muc 6.1 - va doc lich su gan day trong docs/exchanges/2026-09-13.md (vong coaching Q12-Q21) de nam boi canh day du truoc khi ra soat. Toi (Claude) vua de xuat danh sach 21 man hinh/popup can tao cho CR nay, chia theo 5 lat trien khai (Lat 2-6):

LAT 2 (danh tinh): (1) Man 'Chon team va vai tro mong muon' [FR-2]; (2) Trang 'Dang cho duyet' [FR-2/3]; (3) Popup bat buoc 'Da duoc cap team X, vai tro Y' [FR-3]; (4) Popup 'Quyen cua ban da bi thay doi' dung chung toan app [FR-4a].

LAT 3 (team/phan quyen): (5) Khu quan tri - trang rieng gom 6 khu con: (5a) Teams & Leader, (5b) Bang hien thi chuc nang, (5c) Vai dac biet (chon team dieu phoi + bat FR-28a tung team), (5d) URL Redmine he thong, (5e) Nhat ky thao tac (metadata, Admin), (5f) Nguoi cho duyet; (6) Popup tao team moi; (7) Man quan ly team cua Leader - tab Thanh vien [FR-12/17]; (8) - tab Nhat ky [FR-11a]; (9) Popup canh bao truoc khi bot thanh vien [FR-12a]; (10) UI header: bo chon team hien tai [FR-13]; (11) UI header: chuong thong bao + dropdown [FR-34].

LAT 4 (du lieu): (12) Sua popup sua task Project them chon nhieu nguoi phu trach + khoang thoi gian rieng [FR-16] - khong co man moi.

LAT 5 (chuc nang): (13) Sua man Bao cao tuan doi trong tam sang danh sach task [FR-21a]; (14) Task ca nhan khong doi [FR-31]; (15) Them cong tac rieng tu/chia se trong man soan Mind Map [FR-32]; (16) Sua man Cai dat (Member) bot URL Redmine [FR-33].

LAT 6 (release nhieu team): (17) Man moi 'Lich release chung' [FR-24/25]; (18) Sua tab 'Cau hinh dot' tai dung UI co san [FR-23]; (19) Man con moi 'Checklist ca nhan khi release' [FR-28a]; (20) Popup 'Yeu cau mo khoa' [FR-26]; (21) UI inline duyet yeu cau mo khoa, cung kieu 'Nguoi cho duyet' [FR-26].

Cau hoi can Council tra loi ro: (1) Danh sach nay co THIEU man/popup nao thuc su can (doi chieu tung FR trong CR, dac biet cac FR co the bi bo sot vi khong noi ro trong §6.1 nhu FR-1/1a dang nhap OIDC co can man loi rieng khong, FR-5 da bi BO hoan toan nen khong con lien quan)? (2) Co man/popup nao trong danh sach la THUA - co the gop chung voi man/popup khac de giam so luong ma khong mat chuc nang (vd co man nao lam duoc bang each mo rong man da co thay vi tao moi)? (3) Cho phuong an toi uu nhat - so man/popup it nhat co the ma van du chuc nang, neu Council thay gop duoc. Tra loi PASS neu danh sach da toi uu, hoac liet ke tung de xuat them/bot/gop cu the.
